column1: # Nebula light for OpenNGC: emission or reflection, from published catalogs.
# Source: Sharpless S. 1959, A Catalogue of H II Regions, ApJS 4, 257 (1959ApJS....4..257S) (VizieR VII/20)
# Source: Rodgers A.W., Campbell C.T., Whiteoak J.B. 1960, A catalogue of H-alpha emission regions in the southern Milky Way, MNRAS 121, 103 (1960MNRAS.121..103R) (VizieR VII/216)
# Source: Anderson L.D., Bania T.M., Balser D.S., Cunningham V., Wenger T.V., Johnstone B.M., Armentrout W.P. 2014, The WISE catalog of Galactic HII regions, ApJS 212, 1 (2014ApJS..212....1A)

# Source: Cederblad S. 1946, Studies of bright diffuse galactic nebulae with special regard to their spatial distribution, Medd. Lunds Astron. Obs. Ser. II, 119, 1 (1946MeLu2.119....1C) (VizieR VII/231)
# Source: Magakian T.Yu. 2003, Merged catalogue of reflection nebulae, A&A 399, 141 (2003A&A...399..141M)
# Rule: a source entry that names the nebula, or lies within its half major axis + 2 arcmin, matches
column2: any emission match is emission, only reflection matches is reflection.
